ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution with high-contrast (white) pixels comprising approximately 15-20% of the surface area, localized primarily at the trailing edge margins and within linear scar patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark mass across the central and inferior regions; high-contrast light-grey to white mottling and linear clusters concentrated in the superior-lateral quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 35 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration map across the entire trailing boundary; extreme pixel-amplitude variations (jaggedness) detected at the far right distal tip, contrasting with more uniform serrations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curves along the trailing edges, exhibiting a moderate upward sweep from the median notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular pixel clusters detected along the superior margin of the right lobe and scattered sparsely across the superior-medial region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of intersecting vertical and diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks); high-density cluster of at least 5-7 parallel dark-on-light marks on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular protrusions and high-contrast calcified-type clusters (barnacles) on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe; extensive rake-mark scarring across the superior half of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique three-point parallel vertical dark scarring on the superior-lateral left lobe; asymmetric jagged erosion on the far right trailing edge.
